description: Route-2 acquisition cold_email->referral: the one decision field neither v1 nor v2 ever moved or listed in a catalog. Route 2 is market-capped at 62.5 clients under BOTH channels, but referral converts ~8x better per prospect-hour (3 prospects/hr x 12% vs 35/hr x 0.23%), so it reaches the same cap with ~313 acquisition hours instead of ~1392. Revenue is unchanged; ~1079 fewer productive hours means ~35 kEUR less opportunity cost. Expect a large KEEP that falsifies v2's 'all levers confirmed at optimum'.

Route-1 build price 1200->1225: v2 probed only UPWARD (1200->1500) and concluded 'the floor is optimal'. Route-1 revenue is clients(pb) x (pb + care_rev), a downward parabola in pb whose vertex sits at ~1227, just ABOVE the 1200 declared floor. Expect a KEEP that is numerically real but commercially meaningless, falsifying the word 'floor' while leaving 'loss-lead the build' intact.

PROBE care price 200->175 (DOWN from the interior optimum): v2's r8 only tested 200->250, so its 'true interior peak' claim rested on a one-sided test. pc x care_factor(pc) is a downward parabola with vertex at exactly 200, so the 175 side must also lose. Expect DISCARD, converting v2's one-sided claim into a two-sided bracket.

PROBE build price 1225->1300 (UP from the r2 interior peak): brackets the vertex from above at a much finer step than v2's 1200->1500. Together with the 1200 baseline below it, this makes the build claim two-sided and pins the peak inside [1200,1300]. Expect DISCARD.

PROBE Route-1 segment handwerk->beauty (2nd-largest pool, 45/yr vs 60/yr): both v1 and v2 carried 'handwerk = largest reachable pool' as an assertion across every round without ever moving the field. Route-1 hours currently saturate the handwerk pool almost exactly, so a smaller pool strands demo hours and sheds clients. Expect DISCARD, converting the assertion into a tested result.

PROBE allocation local 0.24->0.23: v2's r6 only tested the far corner (b2b 1.0). The winner actually sits at a CONSTRAINT INTERSECTION, not a smooth interior optimum: Route-1 hours saturate the handwerk pool almost exactly, and Route-2 oversight capacity only just covers the market cap. Shaving 1pp off local strands Route-1 pool without buying anything on Route-2, which is already capped. Expect DISCARD, showing 0.24 is an edge rather than a peak.
